subject: LiDAR + video workflow post-Blickfeld
text:

Congrats on closing the Blickfeld acquisition! Bringing proprietary LiDAR
hardware in-house is a big move for [COMPANY]'s competitive moat in Perimeter
Intrusion Detection. As you integrate these point clouds with your existing
video analytics, I imagine the focus is shifting to sensor fusion to keep
nuisance alarm rates low at edge deployments.

2D/3D streams at scale - that's where Encord fits. We support Toyota,
Skydio, Thales, Flock Safety) to unify video + LiDAR pipelines, improve
throughput, and tighten QA for threat detection.

Curious if that's a friction point you're already navigating?

subject: model performance feedback loop
text:
Hi [NAME], 

 We recently began working with Veriff and Onfido, and [COMPANY] came up given your position in the IDV space. 

 A common theme we're hearing: once models are live, the challenges shift to diagnosing failure modes and tightening the feedback loop between training data and production performance - especially in high-stakes KYC/AML environments. 

 That's where Encord fits - we support IDV and FinTech teams across doc, image, audio, biometrics, and video workflows - from curation, annotation, to HITL QA, and model eval. 

 Is this something you're focused on? Happy to connect and compare notes - I'm flexible Wed - Fri if you're open to chat.

text:
